post.title: Why Trying to Be Happy Ruins the Night #shorts
post.description: Which night was yours? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend planning a perfect birthday. Rosa's birthday has to be the happiest night of her life, so she keeps checking whether she's happy yet. In 'Can Seeking Happiness Make People Unhappy? Paradoxical Effects of Valuing Happiness' (Emotion, 2011), Iris Mauss, Maya Tamir, Craig Anderson and Nicole Savino had people read a newspaper article praising the importance of happiness (or a neutral version), then watch a happy film clip. The people nudged to value happiness felt less happy during the happy clip, and their disappointment explained it. Chasing happiness turns a good moment into a test, and tests disappoint. Stop grading the night. #psychology #shorts #happiness #overthinking #birthday
